items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1959-10-26
items.q: I put that with Charles H. Hanson Music Publishers. And he'll take more if I put them on tape.

ctx.x: ...piece of sheet of sheet of sheet. And I had good luck on one of them. This last group. Yes. I put that with Charles H. Hanson Music Publishers. And he'll take more if I put them on tape. He's looking for original music of Nick LaRocca. And I couldn't tell you more on that. You've got some more. Oh yes. I've got about 40, 50 numbers. I have 25 of them I just had copyrighted in the last year. 25 copyrighted?
